description: Perform an effortless, comprehensive QA audit on the active screen: checks for UI responsiveness errors, RenderFlex overflows, layout overlap, truncated text, broken/placeholder data (null, undefined, NaN), and logcat exceptions.

checkLogs.description: Whether to inspect recent logcat for exceptions/errors (default true).

targetId.description: Target Android device ID; defaults to active session default.

name: audit_screen
title: Audit Screen QA
